_readme: Entries shown on the aquarium information panel. Edit freely. Each entry: name, latin, lines (array of paragraphs). Keep them funny but genuinely useful - they are hint level 3.
title: RESIDENTS OF THE DEEP TANK
footer: Please do not tap the glass.

entries.name: GREATER BLIMP
lines: Docile. Curious. Attracted to small vibrations.
Capable of moving objects several times its own weight, although apparently unaware of this.

entries.name: LESSER BASTARDS
lines: Will chew anything near a commotion. Do not encourage.

entries.name: PANIC EEL ("THE COWARD")
lines: When alarmed, travels rapidly and in a perfectly straight line AWAY from the source.

entries.name: GLASS SUCKER
lines: Strongly attracted to movement along transparent surfaces.
Staff are advised not to clean the glass during feeding.

entries.name: THE IDIOT
lines: Testing abandoned after specimen repeatedly copied the researcher.

entries.name: UNLISTED
lines: This entry has been removed at the request of the night staff.
